thread:
maya (product): Quick sync thread — we need cross-team alignment on the tenant-priority launch. Main asks: launch criteria, sequencing, infra slots, security checklist. Who can own sequencing?
chris (eng-runtime): I can own runtime sequencing. Need concrete SLOs and a fallback model list (quantized variants).
leo (eng-infra): Infra can reserve 2 burst pools + 1 staging slot for the pilot. Need target dates and expected RPS to lock in capacity.
maya (product): Proposed target week: 2024-09-09. Expected peak RPS 250, sustained 100. Sound reasonable?
sam (eng-sre): From oncall POV: require a canary window (2h) and an automated rollback hook. Also need perf tests in the release pipeline before canary.
jen (eng-platform): +1 to perf tests. Quick perf config we use for initial runs:
```
batch_size: 64
kv_cache: true
seq_len: 1024
concurrent_reqs: 50
```
chris (eng-runtime): Thanks — I'll run the harness with that config and produce latency/p95/cost numbers. Fallback plan: if p95 > 400ms, switch to quantized-8 variant.
tara (eng-security): Security checklist: threat model + HSM/KMS integration for keys, plus a scoped pen-test. ETA ~3 weeks for HSM hookup. If not ready by launch, we require data redaction on customer payloads.
alex (product): Product can accept a softened SLA for first 2 weeks (best-effort) if infra and observability are shipped. We'll communicate that to pilots.
leo (eng-infra): Noted. I'll tentatively book the pools and confirm after the perf run on 2024-08-20.
maya (product): Action items: 1) chris: perf harness + results (attach to this thread), 2) leo: reserve pools + confirm by 08/20, 3) tara: run threat model + timeline, 4) sam: create rollback runbook & canary playbook, 5) alex: update launch doc and external comms. Please ping in 48h with updates. :raised_hands:
deploy-bot: perf-run job #478 queued by chris for config batch_size=64 (ETA ~30m)
chris (eng-runtime): Starting perf harness now, will post results and artifacts to the launch doc when done.
